VERIFY list:
- MO-SHARE-A-TIME — written-test time limit not printed in the guide (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- MO-SHARE-D-STOPDIST — car stopping distance printed as two adjacent numbers (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- MO-SHARE-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- MO-SHARE-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the littering fine and jail limits (sec05-F52) are statutory and can change, and the highway emergency phone number (sec05-F50) should be rechecked against current Highway Patrol guidance.
